title: Keep closing comparison endpoint only for an admitted evaluation request
outcome: A request refused after source measurement does not silently establish a closing comparison endpoint that hides an earlier unobserved interval.
acceptance: Behavioral fixture covers missing ordinary baseline, X-to-Y edit, evaluation request that measures Y then is refused, and close at Y; it distinguishes refused admission from a successful request.

Retention occurs at an appropriate admitted request boundary, preserving scope rechecks, same-turn lifetime, ordinary/registered precedence and successful unchanged evaluation behavior; any alternative contract is explicitly concurred before evaluation.
